visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a bright, modern office studio. A man in a black t-shirt and a woman in a tan long-sleeve top stand facing each other. A large floating graphic of a water bottle and the text '水瓶遊戲' are centered. A real water bottle hangs from the ceiling by a white cord, positioned between the two subjects. (2) Round 1 begins. Both characters wear black eye masks acting as blindfolds. The man reaches out with his right hand and swings the suspended bottle towards the woman's head. She flinches, squinting her eyes behind the mask and tilting her torso back to avoid the impact. The background features orange and blue lounge chairs. (3) Round 2 follows. The woman takes her turn to swing the bottle toward the man. He leans back smoothly, avoiding the plastic bottle as it passes his face. Yellow exclamation graphics appear to emphasize the near-miss. Both characters are smiling and laughing throughout the physical game. (4) Round 3 shows the man swinging the bottle again. This time, the bottle makes direct contact with the woman's forehead. She reacts by bending forward and laughing loudly, covering her face with her hands. Red motion lines are edited around the bottle to highlight the successful hit. (5) In the final phase, the man removes his blindfold and holds it up to the camera lens. He points out several small pinholes in the fabric that allowed him to see. He smiles mischievously at the camera while the woman stands in the background with a playful, annoyed expression. Social media icons and a follow prompt appear.
